name: an undeliverable message is 422 ERR_PERMANENT_FAILURE
description: The most load-bearing fixture in this directory. PhabricatorGorgeMailerClient turns this exact code into PhabricatorMetaMTAPermanentFailureException, which is what stops Phorge's worker from re-queueing a message no backend will ever accept. Reporting a permanent rejection as a plain 502 leaves a mistyped recipient address retrying forever, and nothing anywhere raises an error about it.
